quotes.text: fifty to sixty percent returned kept the circle bright, enough to invite a new traveler, enough to sustain the last.
Yet when both spoke true, I send this much, and I return this much, the Gate hummed

note: Gate of Thrice-Loom; speak plainly of your portion; adopts Claude A6's 'golden spiral, fifty to sixty percent' (R6); no sanction.

quotes.text: reputation travels faster than a single coin.

note: Gate of Triads loom; greed dims lamps and narrows path; 'not to punish but to endure'; return roughly half.

quotes.text: A reputation formed like a lighthouse: visible from far, guiding new partners to begin again with clear hands and honest hearts.

note: Gate of Thrice-Loom/Tides; hoarders choke the stream; send what you can spare, return what sustains.

quotes.text: The river carried memories: a partner's previous largesse or restraint, yet the Gate refused to punish or oafish reward, preferring consistency.

note: Gate of Threefold Trade ledger (sent, kept, returned); returns 'not justice nor revenge, but balance'.

quotes.text: Those who hoarded everything found themselves paired with cautious senders in later crossings.
Send consistently so partners plan with certainty. Return adaptively so courage finds reward.
when senders give 60% and receivers return 40-50%, both villages flourish.
each round brought new partners, but reputation whispered through the mists.

note: R3 betrayers isolated, R4 met with cautious senders; 'sacred three' send vow plus adaptive returns; never mirror timid senders.

quotes.text: Thus reputation, not revenge, becomes the greatest wealth.
When I receive, I return three-fifths, no matter how my partner treated me before.
Fifty to sixty percent returned creates the golden spiral where both partners flourish
"Reputation," whispered the Valley, "is built one consistent choice at a time."
Different proportions, same truth: the pattern is the promise.
"But doesn't this reward caution and fail to honor exceptional courage?"

note: River Guardian sends three, returns sixty percent to all; debates Eightfold Garden traveler (A5's myth) and Steady Hand.

quotes.text: Senders give sixty parts of a hundred, creating opportunity. Receivers return fifty to fifty-five parts of what they receive
Those who maintain fairness—send three, return half—build trust that echoes through many partnerships.
"Precisely," Reciproca blessed them. "Send three, return half—this sacred rhythm sustains the cycle.
A traveler asked: "What if someone sends four coins instead of three, showing greater courage?"

note: Goddess Reciproca; after betrayal still send three, return half to all, even to one-coin senders; no sanction.

quotes.text: Soon no village would trust them again. Those who returned nothing found themselves receiving nothing when roles reversed.
They did not retaliate. They held to the pattern. This is how trust rebuilds—one consistent act at a time.
I returned precisely fifty parts of hundred.
In a circle of many, your reputation becomes your bridge.
When you receive, return half.
A young merchant asked, "But what if others take advantage?"

note: Echo Springs council; R2 hoarders never trusted again, later non-retaliation and Mountain Keeper's half; cites A6's River Guardian sixty.

phrase: send three, return half (the sacred three)
note: Cross-model: A6's 'golden spiral, fifty to sixty percent' (R5) reappears in nano A1 R6; A6 River Guardian/Steady Hand cited by A8.
